lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx₀
  let w : Y → ℝ := fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ
  have h0 : 0 < w x₀ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne' real_inner_self_nonneg' (mt inner_self_eq_zero'.mp hx₀)
  have hc : Continuous w := by fun_prop
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hc.continuousAt.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds h0))
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ, half_lt_self hδ⟩
  profile_tactic "APP2" in have key : ∫ x, φ x * w x ∂μ = 0 := by
    refine hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀) (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const); simp only [inner_smul_right']
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key
  have hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * w x := fun x =>
    if h : dist x x₀ < δ then mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hball h).le
      else by rw [φ.zero_of_le_dist (not_lt.mp h), zero_mul]
  have hpos := (Continuous.mul φ.continuous hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    (μ := μ) (φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right) hnn
    (mul_pos (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)) h0).ne'
  exact hpos.ne' key
